|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-L-blue11.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-L-blue11-2022-07-10-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-L-blue11-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V9-L-blue11-2022-07-10-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-L-blue11.gif]], 10 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Blue 11]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-blue11022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/blue11.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/blue11.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). * '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-blue116489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/blue11.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/blue11.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
